cite_as: La Torre, D., Leon, S., Wang, J., et al. (2019). Long-Term Outcome Study: A Longitudinal Study of LA's BEST Students' Persistence and Graduation Rates. CRESST Report 862. ERIC ED594613.

cite_as: Huang, D., Kim, K. S., Cho, J., Marshall, A., et al. (2011). Keeping Kids in School: A Study Examining the Long-Term Impact of Afterschool Enrichment Programs on Students' High School Dropout Rates (LA's BEST). Earlier version: Huang et al. (2005), CRESST.

cite_as: Arcaira, E., Vile, J. D., & Reisner, E. R. (2010, August). Achieving High School Graduation: Citizen Schools' Youth Outcomes in Boston. Washington, DC: Policy Studies Associates.
